notes.title: 🚀 Development Progress Update: The First Dream — Lunar Base Technology
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637990/c946666cbf50acb6a23d9690bb4163e94c7c8d43.png"][/img][b]Scene Background[/b][/p][p]In [b]the game[/b], the player's adventure begins with "entering the dream." In the first dream, players are transported to the [b]Lunar Base[/b], a place where modern technology meets mystical practices.[/p][list][*][p][b]Base Design[/b]: It combines modern technology with elements of traditional beliefs, with the cold surface of the Moon contrasting against metallic structures, blurring the line between the virtual and the real.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Technology and Secrets[/b]: Inside the base, there are complex laboratories, energy cores, and mysterious areas for gathering materials. Players will uncover various secrets.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Scene Structure[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Command Center[/b]: The central area of the base where players discover key elements of the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy Reactors[/b]: High-risk, high-reward areas where players must fight enemies and complete missions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Research Laboratories[/b]: Explore various materials and technological devices that unlock new items and abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Training Arenas[/b]: Players can practice and improve their combat skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Residential Modules[/b]: Hidden areas with small resources and items that help players restore their supplies.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]First-Person Shooting[/b]: Shooting is the main mechanic of the game, combining traditional FPS style with mystical elements, offering intense and dynamic combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Gathering[/b]: In the Lunar Base, players can gather various materials (such as ginseng, lingzhi, goji, etc.) that are used to create elixirs and enhance abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death and Exploration Mechanics[/b]: In this dream, players will experience the classic "death with resource loss" mechanic, but some collected items (like those in the safe) will be preserved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlocking Abilities[/b]: By collecting artifacts or completing missions, players will unlock new abilities that make them stronger.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Development Plans[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Level Design Improvements[/b]: We continue to refine the Lunar Base by adding new interactive elements, enemies, and hidden areas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Experience Optimization[/b]: We are working to better integrate the shooting and artifact systems to make the combat smoother and more engaging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adding New Dreams[/b]: As the first dream progresses, we will begin working on the second dream and offer new challenges to players.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Thanks and Expectations[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your support and patience! As an independent developer, I am striving to create a unique experience for players. Your feedback and suggestions are very important to me, so feel free to comment and help us improve the game.[/p][p]— [b]Game Developer[/b][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Dream of Origin — Are You Ready to Face the Overmind?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637990/477d11d9fccc046a437fe7d868d10aefe1fc5fe3.png[/img]
Have you ever questioned if the world is real? Have you felt the pull of something beyond?

Primordial Dream is now available to wishlist on Steam!

In this action game blending philosophical fantasy and survival trials, you are extracted from reality and placed inside the Taiyi System — a higher-dimensional simulation testing the legitimacy of humanity’s existence.

🌀 Rogue-lite dream dungeons × Consciousness evolution system × Multi-ending narrative
⚔️ Third-person action × Symbolic combat × Psychological choices
🎧 Immersive visual and audio with Eastern mysticism and cyber-symbolism

You are not the hero — you are a variable.
You are not the savior — you are a test subject.
But perhaps, you can deliver an answer the Overmind will accept.

Primordial Dream is being crafted by a small indie team seeking to merge philosophy with fantasy.
If you’ve ever pondered meaning, self, or simulation, we invite you to join us.

💡 Add it to your wishlist — see you in the dream.
